name: Aim High Academy Summer Day Camps
description_short: Summer day camps at Aim High Academy in East Greenwich for ages 3 to 10: Camp Little Star for preschoolers (3 to 5) and Camp Rising Star for rising 1st to 5th graders. Weekly themes mix indoor and outdoor activities, including arts & crafts, games, gymnastics, adventure play and water play, with a theme-based Fun Friday and pizza lunch each Friday.
refund_policy_summary: $150 non-refundable deposit per session at registration; balances due May 1 (June camps), June 1 (July camps) and July 1 (August camps). No refunds or credits without a medical note; $25 fee to change the schedule. $25 registration fee for non-members.
swim_waterfront_notes: Water play only: preschoolers wear bathing suits daily; school-age campers bring a bathing suit for water play (water slides on Fun Fridays).
